about: Opponent profiles for the postflop trainer. Each profile gives the villain's preflop calling ranges; the hero's ranges always come from preflop.json. A range written as "@SCENARIO.call" reuses that scenario's call range from preflop.json. Edit ranges here; the code only reads them.

ranges.ccVsEarly: 22-JJ, A2s-AQs, K8s+, Q9s+, J9s+, T8s+, 97s+, 86s+, 75s+, 65s, 54s, A9o-AQo, KTo+, QTo+, JTo, T9o, 98o
